sentences.text: Croatia -LRB- -LSB- kroʊˈeɪʃə -RSB- ; Hrvatska -LSB- xř̩ʋaːtskaː -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Republic of Croatia -LRB- -LSB- Republika Hrvatska , links = no -RSB- , -RRB- , is a sovereign state between Central Europe , Southeast Europe , and the Mediterranean .	sovereign state	sovereign state	Mediterranean	Mediterranean Sea

Its capital city is Zagreb , which forms one of the country 's primary subdivisions , along with its twenty counties .	Zagreb	Zagreb	primary subdivisions	administrative divisions of Croatia	twenty counties	Counties of Croatia
Croatia covers 56594 km2 and has diverse , mostly continental and Mediterranean climates .	Mediterranean	Mediterranean Sea	continental	Continental climate
Croatia 's Adriatic Sea coast contains more than a thousand islands .	Adriatic Sea	Adriatic Sea	more than a thousand islands	List of islands of Croatia
The country 's population is 4.28 million , most of whom are Croats , with the most common religious denomination being Roman Catholicism .	Croats	Croats	Roman Catholicism	Catholic Church
The Croats arrived in the area of present-day Croatia during the early part of the 7th century AD .	Croats	Croats
They organised the state into two duchies by the 9th century .
Tomislav became the first king by 925 , elevating Croatia to the status of a kingdom .	Tomislav	Tomislav of Croatia

The Kingdom of Croatia retained its sovereignty for nearly two centuries , reaching its peak during the rule of Kings Petar Krešimir IV and Dmitar Zvonimir .	Kingdom	Kingdom of Croatia (925–1102)	Kingdom of Croatia	Kingdom of Croatia (925–1102)	Petar Krešimir IV	Petar Krešimir IV of Croatia	Dmitar Zvonimir	Demetrius Zvonimir of Croatia
Croatia entered a personal union with Hungary in 1102 .	personal union	Croatia in the union with Hungary	Hungary	Kingdom of Hungary

In 1527 , faced with Ottoman conquest , the Croatian Parliament elected Ferdinand I of the House of Habsburg to the Croatian throne .	Croatian	Croatian language	Ottoman conquest	Hundred Years' Croatian–Ottoman War	Ferdinand I	Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor	House of Habsburg	House of Habsburg

During the early 19th century , parts of the country were split into the French Illyrian Provinces , and Austria-Hungary occupied its Bosnia and Herzegovina side -- a dispute settled by the 1878 Treaty of Berlin . In 1918 , after World War I , Croatia was included in the unrecognized State of Slovenes , Croats and Serbs which seceded from Austria-Hungary and merged into the Kingdom of Yugoslavia . A fascist Croatian puppet state backed by Fascist Italy and Nazi Germany existed during World War II .	Croatian	Croatian language	fascist Croatian puppet state	Independent State of Croatia	World War II	World War II

After the war , Croatia became a founding member and a federal constituent of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia , a constitutionally socialist state .	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia	socialist state	socialist state
On 25 June 1991 Croatia declared independence , which came wholly into effect on 8 October of the same year .	declared independence	Independence of Croatia
The Croatian War of Independence was fought successfully during the four years following the declaration .	Croatian	Croatian language	Croatian War of Independence	Croatian War of Independence
A unitary state , Croatia is a republic governed under a parliamentary system .	unitary state	unitary state	parliamentary system	parliamentary system

The International Monetary Fund classified Croatia as an emerging and developing economy , and the World Bank identified it as a high-income economy .	International Monetary Fund	International Monetary Fund	World Bank	World Bank	high-income economy	World Bank high-income economy

Croatia is a member of the European Union -LRB- EU -RRB- , United Nations -LRB- UN -RRB- , the Council of Europe , NATO , the World Trade Organization -LRB- WTO -RRB- and a founding member of the Union for the Mediterranean . As an active participant in the UN peacekeeping forces , Croatia has contributed troops to the NATO-led mission in Afghanistan and took a non-permanent seat on the UN Security Council for the 2008 -- 2009 term . The service sector dominates Croatia 's economy , followed by the industrial sector and agriculture .	service sector	service sector	industrial sector	industrial sector
International Tourism is a significant source of revenue during the summer , with Croatia ranked the 18th most popular tourist destination in the world .	International Tourism	Tourism in Croatia
The state controls a part of the economy , with substantial government expenditure .
The European Union is Croatia 's most important trading partner .	European Union	European Union	trading partner	international trade
